full_page.content:
1937, September
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 213 Cont.
Sep. 16th Sally Ann Garvin - 2 - had brain-fever when 6 months old - has been quite abnormal ever since - very restless.
Mrs. Nellie Patterson - elderly - wants good girl or lady to stay with her - room rent free .. 1821 Beaufait
Lawrence Belleau - 44 - cancer of throat and tuomers - fears 2nd operation.
Mrs. Norma Whitman ... fallen stomach etc. Norman Ryan - 34 - Very hard of hearing .... away
Page 214 Sep. Mrs. Charles Doran - selling corsetts ... poor sales - success Mrs. Mildred Manning - 68 - breast removed January - was in fearful pain; daughter enrolled her while in agony and pain vanished com- pletely now almost entirely well. Deo Br .!
Theresa Hazel - 43 - fears operation Mrs. Jos. Cartright - 52 - cataract and pains in side Lula Kina - severe headaches and pains in back. Elwood Thomas Brady - 34 - mental
Mrs. Schroeder - elderly - wants to sell her house ... to ... save it.
Page 215 Sep. 29
Daniel Cahill - 50 - nerveous, anxious Phillip Zerilli -2 1/6 has had 24 transfusions; expecting 25th soon Stanley Adamcheck - 46 - gall-bl. trouble Rita Adamcheck - 15 - crippled since 22 months old - fears operation Ramond Sass - 24 - nervous ...? doctors guessing. Was to be married now? ? ?
Able Lysy - 47 - drinking, neglecting family duties ....
